'''2000 Mega Weekend''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG tournament weekend in late 2000, played as Swiss rounds. Brian Hunter went undefeated in 10 games there with a Light Echo Base Operations X-wing list.<ref name="dt-11872">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11872 EBO done RIGHT aka The Real Deal], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 19 November 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11872/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11872/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018092852/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11872/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 3–5 November 2000<ref name="tr-d1429">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-07-phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-oned1429/ phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-one], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 7 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-07-phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-oned1429/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
* '''Site:''' Arizona Gamer (AZ Gamer), Phoenix area, Arizona<ref name="tr-d1434">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-07-pheonix-arizona-10-3-00-day-one-mega-td1434/ pheonix-arizona-10-3-00-day-one-mega-t], DeckTech (Your "thezrhino" Mom, 7 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-07-pheonix-arizona-10-3-00-day-one-mega-td1434/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]] (the reports' decks use its objectives)<ref name="tr-d1441">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-10-phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-3d1441/ phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-3], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 10 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-10-phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-3d1441/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
